assets.review: Original environmental interpretation generated and wired to the Jin'do node. Human in-game resemblance review remains open.

assets.visualIntent: Distinct physical Hakkar: towering crimson serpent god with blue feathered crest and wings and restrained bronze ornament, clearly unlike the skeletal teal Sunken Temple avatar.

assets.review: Original character cutout with genuine alpha, converted to WebP and wired to the physical summoning node; not reused for the avatar or banishment aftermath. Human creature-model comparison remains open.
